name: The Very Impossible Obby
desc:
Welcome to the Very Impossible Obby, the obby will get very difficult and hard!

Do you have what it takes to beat The Very Impossible Obby? With over 260 stages, the stages gets more difficult as you make it through every obstacle in this platformer obby.

Don't forget to like the game!

You can press R to respawn instantly to your stage.

Tags: Obby, Impossible, Hard, Platformer, Obstacle Course, Tower, Difficult, Difficulty Chart, Easy, DCO, Parkour, Teamwork
